text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee on the implementation of the switch to biodiesel including the impact on vehicles, the cost implications, and the reduction in Greenhouse Gasses in the City's Fleet operations, as requested by the City Council on February 18, 2021.
The Infrastructure and Environment committee received the report (August 30, 2021) from the Acting General Manager, Fleet Services Division for information.
